params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
$wt=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'agent-worktrees\complete-workflows-final-r2-20260929-chatgpt'
$branch='local/complete-workflows-final-r2-20260929-chatgpt'
git -C $repo fetch origin --prune
git -C $repo worktree prune
if(Test-Path $wt){ throw ('worktree path already exists: '+$wt) }
git -C $repo worktree add -b $branch $wt origin/main
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'WORKTREE_ADD_FAILED' }
$env:OPENCODE_CONFIG='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\opencode-fallback.json'
$oc='C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-tools\opencode\package\bin\opencode.exe'
Push-Location $wt
try {
  $prompt=@'
You are the final integration engineer for fengie/mhw-mods. This is the last ordinary branch preventing branch-zero.

Read AGENTS.md and all current repository instructions first. Reconstruct current origin/main before editing. Historical source: origin/codex/complete-mod-workflows at cae2407e5245ab27339967f2b5522a37c1e60152. Primary implementation commit: 02fa1dd5c3e98d319067043598bfdfd32617e65f.

DO NOT merge or replay that branch wholesale. Its old continuity/version/verification/CI history is stale. Selectively port useful product code, tests, and durable docs onto this fresh current-main worktree, preserving every newer behavior/invariant on main.

Prior audit proves the historical commit conflicts only in a small set of product integration files plus stale metadata. High-value missing capabilities include FomodInstallerService + chooser UI, RulesEditorService, UpdateMigrationService, GameAdapters, WorkflowAnalysis, WorkflowWindow/UI wiring, WORKFLOWS/GAME-ADAPTER-SDK docs, richer collection recipes, relevant crash-bisector improvements, FOMOD SmartInbox hold behavior, deployment/storage metadata changes, and workflow tests.

Preserve current SafeRecursiveTraversal and modern ExtractSafelyAsync containment APIs, current launch/trust atomicity, profile identity, updater behavior, current release/version identity, current CI, current continuity/checkpoint files, and .verification cache. Resolve conflicts semantically, never by wholesale ours/theirs.

Verification before commit:
1. git diff --check
2. dotnet build MhwModManager.sln -c Release -m:1 -warnaserror
3. run relevant built Core/Automation/Storage/Integration test assemblies, especially workflow/FOMOD/recipe/crash/deployment coverage; run broader bounded backend suites where feasible
4. run self-test if applicable
Fix failures caused by the port and do not weaken tests.

Commit one coherent reconciliation commit locally. DO NOT push. End by printing BASE origin/main SHA, FINAL HEAD SHA, files changed, exact verification commands/results, and any limitations.
'@
  & $oc run --standalone --auto --model 'ollama/qwen2.5-coder:7b' --format json $prompt
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'LOCAL_AGENT_FAILED' }
  Write-Output '=== FINAL_STATUS ==='
  git status --short
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git log -3 --oneline
  git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
} finally { Pop-Location }
